messages:
mike_ops: FRA inbound flagged for physical inspection, forwarder says hold + ~10-14 day delay for the sea portion. We received 30 units, 5 DOA. Need routing, RMA flow, and cost decision.
vendor-liaison: Opened RMA 2026-900. DOA serials attached in the ticket. We can split shipments: up to 18 air replacements now, remainder by sea. Air premium +$1,350/unit.
ida: Paste DOA serials here please so depot can start RMAs. Also confirm HS code and whether invoice was updated.
vendor-liaison: DOA serials: SN-R9T8Y7U6, SN-R9T8Y7U7, SN-R9T8Y7U8, SN-R9T8Y7U9, SN-R9T8Y7V0. HS 8471.50.80. Invoice amended and re-submitted to customs.
mike_ops: Ops preference: air to FRA for 12 live nodes + replacements, divert up to 6 to AMS if it reduces customs friction.
vendor-liaison: AMS diversion ok but adds ~36-48h transit. We can divert up to 6 units to AMS if confirmed by 18:00 CET.
sam_finance: Vendor proposes 85% pre-credit on DOAs, rest after depot photos. Can vendor increase to 95% if Redwood covers AWB expedite fees? Provide billing reference.
vendor-liaison: We can accept 95% pre-credit if Redwood covers AWB expedite. AWB charge will be invoiced to Redwood REF: RDW-PO-4610. SLA will include 48h dispatch after pre-credit.
rma-bot: RMA 2026-900 created, status: pending-photos. Upload depot photos within 72h to avoid retention hold.
ida: Ops will upload photos. Please include the amended invoice & HS code in the RMA so customs has the paper trail.
mike_ops: Decision: approve 95% pre-credit and AWB coverage for up to 18 air replacements. Confirm diversion: send 6 units to AMS, 12 to FRA by air; sea top-up for remaining units. Mike will coordinate depot uploads.
vendor-liaison: Confirmed SLA: "Dispatch up to 18 air replacements within 48h of pre-credit confirmation; 95% pre-credit for DOA serials upon pre-authorization; remaining 5% after depot photo verification; AWB billed to Redwood account REF: RDW-PO-4610."
sam_finance: Received SLA and billing ref. Initiating pre-credit hold release. Please ensure RMA ticket includes invoice attachments.
mike_ops: Thanks all. I'll post when photos are uploaded and when forwarder confirms AMS diversion. :thumbsup:
